# System Architecture

| Component | Module | Role |
|-----------|--------|------|
| TDDCycleRunner | src/agents/tdd_cycle_runner.py | Orchestrates RED→GREEN→REFACTOR cycle |

| IncrementalPlanner | src/agents/incremental_planner.py | Determines next test increment |

| PodFactory | src/agents/polyglot_tdd_runner.py | Creates LanguagePod instances |

| Reflector | src/core/reflector/module.py | Analyzes task outcomes and extracts insights |

| ContextGraphRetriever | src/retrieval/cgr3_retriever.py | CGR³ retrieval pipeline |
| ContextScorer | src/retrieval/context_scorer.py | Scores bullets against request context |
| PlaybookRepository | src/storage/repository.py | PostgreSQL repository for playbooks |

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Runner as IterativeTDDRunner
    participant Planner as IncrementalPlanner
    participant CycleRunner as TDDCycleRunner
    participant Pod as PythonLanguagePod
    participant Worker as WorkerAgent
    participant Orchestrator as PodmanOrchestrator
    participant Container as PodmanRunner
    participant Reflector as Reflector
    participant Curator as Curator
    participant PlaybookMgr as PlaybookManager
    participant Logger as ExperimentLogger
    participant Audit as AuditClient

    loop for each cycle
        Runner->>Planner: next_increment(requirement, cycle)
        activate Planner
        Planner-->>Runner: TestIncrement
        deactivate Planner

        Runner->>CycleRunner: run(spec)
        activate CycleRunner

        CycleRunner->>Pod: run_red(spec)
        activate Pod
        Pod->>Worker: generate_test(spec)
        activate Worker
        Worker-->>Pod: test_code
        deactivate
